blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Program evolution provides a promising approach to discover agent memory designs and study the choices underlying their effectiveness. We introduce MAPE, a framework that evolves whole memory programs from minimal seeds through a standardized lifecycle interface and an iterative diagnosis-proposal loop. Experiments on LoCoMo and LongMemEval yield an absolute accuracy gain of up to 12% over manually designed baselines at 35% of the serving cost, with further evaluations supporting transfer across serving backbones and benchmarks. Empirical analyses and ablations identify and validate two recurring design patterns: retaining raw conversations as retrievable evidence preserves details omitted from extracted memories, while composing retrieved evidence according to query intent helps the answering model use it effectively. Transplanting the composition module into five existing memory systems improves accuracy across all five. Beyond these patterns, the search objective shapes where computation goes: optimizing serving cost alongside accuracy shifts computation from LLM-based memory construction to selective processing at query time while retaining competitive accuracy. Together, these findings offer empirical lessons for agent memory design. Code is available at https://github.com/ash-ding/MAPE.
blocks.zh: 程序进化为发现代理内存设计并研究其有效性所基于的选择提供了一个有希望的方法. 我们引入了MAPE,这个框架通过一个标准化的生命周期界面和一个迭代的诊断-建议循环,使整个内存程序从最小的种子中演化出来. 在LoCoMo和LongMemEval的实验中,比手工设计的基线的绝对准确度提高12%,占服务成本的35%,进一步评价支持跨服务骨干和基准的转让。 经验分析和模拟确定并验证了两种反复出现的设计模式:保留原始对话作为可检索证据,保留了从所提取记忆中省去的细节,同时根据查询意图整理可检索的证据有助于解答模型有效地使用. 将组成单元移植到五个现有的内存系统中,提高了所有五个系统的准确性。 除这些模式外,搜索目标形状是计算方向:优化服务成本,同时精度计算从基于LLM的内存构造转向在查询时间进行选择性处理,同时保留竞争性精度. 这些结论共同为代理记忆设计提供了经验性的经验教训. 代码见https://github.com/ash-ding/MAPE.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Agents powered by large language models, such as personal assistants and conversational companions ( Wang et al., 2024 ; Xi et al., 2023 ) , increasingly depend on persistent memory of user information to maintain continuity across conversations. Agent memory systems Packer et al. (2023) ; Chhikara et al. (2025) ; Xu et al. (2025) ; Rasmussen et al. (2025) ; Liu et al. (2026a) address this need by transforming interaction history into memory units, organizing them in a persistent store, and retrieving relevant information to support subsequent responses. Prior work has advanced memory representation, organization, maintenance, and retrieval ( Zhang et al., 2024 ) , yet these components are often designed and refined through human expertise.
blocks.zh: 由大型语言模型,如个人助理和对话同伴(Wang等人,2024年;习近平等人,2023年)提供动力的代理,越来越依赖于用户信息的持续内存来保持对话的连续性. 代理内存系统 Packer等人(2023年),Chhikara等人(2025年),许等人(2025年),拉斯穆森等人(2025年),刘等人(2026年a)通过将交互历史转化为记忆单位,组织它们于一个持久储存,并检索相关信息来支持后续反应来解决这一需要. 以前的工作有先进的内存代表,组织,维护和检索(Zhang et al., 2024),然而这些组件往往通过人的专门知识来设计和完善.

blocks.en: Meanwhile, LLM-driven evolutionary search has emerged as a tool for automated scientific discovery and algorithm design ( Romera-Paredes et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2024 ; Ma et al., 2024 ) . Systems such as AlphaEvolve ( Novikov et al., 2025 ) employ an LLM to propose program modifications and automated evaluation to guide subsequent proposals, yielding mathematical constructions and algorithms that outperform established designs. Recent work extends this paradigm to agent memory, evolving prompts, configurations, or executable pipelines to improve memory performance ( Deng et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2026b ; Liu et al., 2026c ).
blocks.zh: 同时,LLM驱动的进化搜索也成为自动科学发现和算法设计的工具(Romera-Paredes等人,2024年;Liu等人,2024年;Ma等人,2024年). AlphaEvolve(Novikov等人,2025年)等系统采用LLM,提出程序修改和自动评价,以指导后续提案,产生超过既定设计的数学构造和算法. 最近的工作将这一范式扩展到代理内存,不断发展的提示,配置,或可执行的管道以改善内存性能(Deng等人,2026年;Liu等人,2026年b;Liu等人,2026年c).

blocks.en: These approaches often constrain the search space to selected components or start from established memory architectures, and primarily emphasize accuracy. We explore a complementary direction: evolving entire memory programs from minimal seeds to study the designs that emerge under different optimization objectives. Beyond finding better programs, we seek to understand how evolution implements effective memory design choices, whether their benefits extend to other memory systems, and how different optimization objectives shape those choices. Explicitly considering serving cost also allows us to study how evolution allocates computation across the memory lifecycle. Specifically, we ask: ❶ What effective memory system designs can whole-program evolution discover from minimal seeds? ❷ How do different optimization objectives shape the evolutionary process and the resulting designs?
blocks.zh: 这些方法往往将搜索空间限制在选定的组件上或从既定的内存架构开始,主要强调准确性. 我们探索一个互补的方向:从最小的种子发展整个内存程序,研究在不同优化目标下出现的设计. 除了寻找更好的程序外,我们寻求了解进化如何执行有效的内存设计选择,其好处是否延伸到其他内存系统,以及不同的优化目标如何塑造这些选择. 明确考虑服务成本还使我们能够研究进化如何分配整个内存生命周期的计算. 我们特别问: 从最小的种子中可以发现什么有效的内存系统设计? 不同的优化目标如何塑造进化过程和由此产生的设计?

blocks.en: To investigate these questions, we develop MAPE , a framework that evolves agent memory systems through whole-program evolution, as illustrated in Figure 1 . A standardized lifecycle interface exposes memory construction, retrieval, and composition ( Xu et al., 2026 ) as programmable stages, so that the entire pipeline is open to revision under a common evaluation protocol. An iterative diagnosis–proposal loop uses execution traces to identify failure patterns and guide subsequent revisions ( Madaan et al., 2023 ; Shinn et al., 2023 ) . Search starts from minimal seeds, such as a program that stores no memory. The framework tracks serving cost across the memory lifecycle and supports both accuracy-only and joint accuracy–cost search.
blocks.zh: 为了调查这些问题,我们开发了MAPE,一个通过全程演化来演化代理记忆系统的框架,如图1所示. 标准化的生命周期接口将内存构造,检索,和组成(徐等人,2026年)暴露为可编程阶段,这样整个管道就可以根据共同的评价协议进行修改. 迭代诊断 - 建议循环使用执行痕迹来识别失败模式并指导随后的修订(Madaan等人,2023年;Shinn等人,2023年)。 搜索从最小种子开始,例如一个不存储内存的程序. 框架跟踪整个内存生命周期的成本,支持只准确性和联合准确性-成本搜索。

blocks.en: We run MAPE on LoCoMo ( Maharana et al., 2024 ) and LongMemEval ( Wu et al., 2025 ) under both objectives, yielding four experimental settings. For each, we analyze the evolutionary trajectory and the resulting memory system. All selected systems outperform the evaluated human-designed baselines on their respective benchmarks. On LoCoMo, we observe an absolute accuracy gain of up to 12% at 35% of the serving cost. Further evaluations include cross-backbone validation using GPT-4.1 mini and Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507 ( Yang et al., 2025 ) , as well as bidirectional cross-benchmark transfer between LoCoMo and LongMemEval, all without additional evolution. These results support the transferability of the discovered memory designs across serving backbones and benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 我们在LoCoMo(Maharana等人,2024年)和LongMemEval(Wu等人,2025年)两个目标下运行了MAPE,产生了四个实验环境. 对于每一个,我们分析进化轨迹 和由此产生的记忆系统。 所有选定的系统都超过了各自基准上经评估的人类设计基线。 在LoCoMo上,我们看到以服务成本35%的绝对精度增益高达12%. 进一步的评价包括使用GPT-4.1微型和Qune3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507(Yang等人,2025年)的交叉背骨验证,以及LoCoMo和LongMemEval之间的双向交叉基准转移,均没有额外的演化. 这些成果支持了所发现的内存设计跨越服务骨干和基准的可转移性。

blocks.en: Across the discovered systems, we identify two recurring design patterns: retaining raw conversations as retrievable evidence and processing retrieved evidence through intent-specific scaffolds before answering. A case study and component ablations examine the contribution of each pattern in a representative system. Retaining raw evidence helps preserve details omitted from extracted memories, while error attribution across human-designed systems identifies incomplete retrieved information as a major bottleneck. The composition module routes queries to intent-specific scaffolds that combine targeted extraction, deterministic computation, and deliberation to support the answering model. Transplantation experiments test this composition strategy across five human-designed memory systems, improving accuracy in every case and demonstrating its utility beyond the evolved program.
blocks.zh: 在整个发现的系统中,我们确定了两种反复出现的设计模式:保留原始对话作为可检索的证据,在回答之前通过特定意图的脚手架处理检索到的证据。 一项案例研究和组成部分汇编审查了每一种模式在代表性系统中的贡献。 保留原始证据有助于保存提取记忆中遗漏的细节,而人类设计的系统的错误归属则将不完全检索到的信息确定为主要瓶颈。 组成模块将查询到意向特定的脚手架上,这些脚脚脚手脚结合了目标提取,决定性的计算,以及考虑来支持解答模式. 移植实验在人类设计的5个内存系统中测试了这种组成策略,提高了每个案例中的准确性,并展示了它超越进化后的程序的效用.

blocks.en: Comparing the two objective settings reveals differences in both search behavior and computation allocation. In the observed runs, accuracy-only search progressively adds operations, accepting substantial cost increases for marginal accuracy gains. The illustrated joint accuracy–cost trajectory maintains lower serving costs and explores more branched candidate lineages, retaining inexpensive alternatives as starting points for further evolution. The resulting designs differ in where they spend computation. The selected accuracy-only programs invest in LLM-based memory construction, whereas the selected accuracy–cost programs reduce reliance on it in favor of selective computation at query time, using 90% and 40% fewer serving calls on LongMemEval and LoCoMo while retaining strong evaluation-set accuracy.
blocks.zh: 比较这两个目标设置,可以发现搜索行为和计算分配上的差异. 在观测到的运行中,仅精度搜索会逐步增加操作量,接受边际精度增益的大幅成本增长. 所说明的联合精度-成本轨迹维持较低的服务成本,并探索更多分支的候选领域,保留廉价的替代品作为进一步演变的起点。 由此产生的设计在计算地点上有所不同。 所选的精准程序投资于基于 LLM 的内存构建,而所选的精准成本程序则减少对它的依赖,有利于在查询时间进行选择性计算,使用90%和40%的更低的服务呼叫LongMemEval和LoCoMo,同时保留强大的评价设定精度.

blocks.en: Our contributions are threefold: • We introduce MAPE , a framework for discovering and studying agent memory designs through whole-program evolution from minimal seeds under a standardized lifecycle interface. • We identify raw-conversation retention and query-dependent composition as recurring design patterns, validate their contributions through ablations, and demonstrate the transferability of composition by transplanting it into five human-designed systems. • We show how optimization objectives shape evolutionary trajectories and computation allocation, with joint accuracy–cost search shifting computation from LLM-based memory construction to selective processing at query time.

blocks.en: 2 The MAPE Framework
blocks.zh: 2 MAPE框架

blocks.en: Figure 1: Overview of MAPE ’s program evolution framework. Candidate programs are proposed using archived designs and diagnostic feedback, checked for execution errors, and evaluated on the search set. Their implementations, results, and diagnoses are retained to guide subsequent proposals. Evolution follows either an accuracy-only objective ( MAPE-A ) or joint accuracy–cost objectives ( MAPE-P ). Shortlisted programs undergo held-out evaluation for final selection.
blocks.zh: 图1:MAPE方案演变框架概述. 候选人程序采用存档设计和诊断反馈,检查执行错误,并在搜索集上进行评估。 它们的执行、结果和诊断被保留下来,以指导随后的建议。 演变要么遵循只精确目标(MAPE-A),要么遵循共同精确成本目标(MAPE-P)。 短名单方案接受搁置评估,供最后选择。

blocks.en: MAPE provides a framework for studying agent memory design through whole-program evolution. This section defines the memory task, program search space, and optimization objectives, then describes the evolutionary process and final program selection.

blocks.en: 2.2 Program Search Space
blocks.zh: 2.2 程序搜索空间

blocks.en: We construct a program search space for exploring diverse memory system designs under a common lifecycle interface ℐ \mathcal{I} . Candidate programs implement memory construction and retrieval and can additionally define how retrieved evidence is composed into the answer context. Evolution can modify these stage implementations and their supporting code. This allows evolution to explore alternative representations, retrieval mechanisms, and evidence-processing procedures, including coordinated changes across stages. Appendix A provides a simplified Python class interface.

blocks.zh: 我们通过检索、组成和回答,衡量为每个历史构建记忆和满足相关询问的象征性成本。 对每段历史 H i H_{i} 和生命周期阶段 s , 我们记录 LLM 输入总量, LLM 输出, 以及嵌入符号, 由 T i 表示, s}^{\i, s}^{\mathrm{in}} , Ti , s_{i, s}^{\mathrm{out}}, 和 Ti, emb_{i, s}^{\mathrm{emb}} 。 我们用相应的按键价格计算舞台成本:C i, s (m) = p in T i, s in + p out T i, s out + p emb Ti, s emb, C_{i, s} (m)=p^{\mathrm{in}}T_{i, s}^{\mathrm{in}}+p^{\mathrm{out}}T_{i, s}^{\mathrm{out}}+p^{\mathrm{embT_{i, s}^{\mathrm{emb}}i, s}^{\mathrm{emb}}, (2)我们将所有四个阶段的费用相加,除以每个历史的回答查询数,将内存构造与它所服务的查询进行摊销. 然后,我们用一个未经加权的平均值,并按每1 000次查询的美元计算结果,得出C-M(m)C-Mathcal{D}}(m)。 这个衡量标准包括LLM和嵌入调用,但不包括裁判和搜索代理调用、本地计算和存储。 它不衡量延迟。 定价详情见附录C。

blocks.en: With both metrics recorded, we run the evolutionary search in two modes: MAPE-A optimizes accuracy alone, whereas MAPE-P treats accuracy and lifecycle serving cost as separate objectives. Its Pareto frontier contains programs for which no other evaluated candidate achieves at least equal accuracy and no greater cost, with a strict improvement in at least one objective ( Deb et al., 2002 ) . The proposer uses this frontier to guide subsequent proposals, while the archive retains all evaluated candidates.
blocks.zh: 两种度量衡都记录下来,我们以两种模式进行进化搜索: MAPE-A单是优化精度,而MAPE-P则将精度和生命周期服务成本作为单独的目标。 其Pareto前沿包含的方案,没有其他被评价的候选人至少获得同等的准确性,成本也不高,至少有一个目标得到严格改善(Deb等人,2002年)。 提议者利用这个前沿来指导随后的提议,而档案则保留了所有被评价的候选人.

blocks.en: 2.4 Evolutionary Search Loop
blocks.zh: 2.4 进化搜索循环

blocks.en: MAPE begins by evaluating the seed programs and placing them in an archive. At each iteration, the proposer consults archived implementations, evaluation results, and diagnoses, selects parent programs, and produces a new candidate with a design hypothesis. The hypothesis states the intended change and its expected benefit, providing a basis for subsequent diagnosis.
blocks.zh: MAPE首先评估种子方案,并将其存档。 在每次迭代时,求婚者会查阅存档的落实,评价结果,以及诊断,选择母程序,并产生一个带有设计假设的新候选人. 该假设陈述了预期的变化及其预期的好处,为随后的诊断提供了依据.

blocks.en: The candidate first undergoes a small sanity evaluation to identify execution errors. The proposer can repair these errors within a fixed budget, and candidates that pass are evaluated on the full fixed search set to obtain accuracy and lifecycle serving cost. A separate diagnosis agent then examines the implementation, design hypothesis, evaluation results, and available execution traces to assess the observed outcome and identify potential causes of failure. The diagnosis informs subsequent proposals without modifying the evaluated candidate.
blocks.zh: 考生首先接受小智评价,以识别执行错误. 提案人可在固定预算中弥补这些错误,通过考试的候选人将接受全套固定搜索,以获得准确性和生命周期服务费用。 然后,一个单独的诊断代理人审查执行情况、设计假设、评价结果和现有的执行痕迹,以评估所观察到的结果,并查明失败的潜在原因。 诊断为随后的提案提供了依据,而不修改被评估的候选人。

blocks.en: After evaluation and diagnosis, the candidate implementation, parent references, hypothesis, results, traces, and diagnosis are added to the archive. All evaluated candidates are retained, including dominated designs, allowing later proposals to revisit earlier implementations rather than extend only the current best program. Search continues until the proposal budget is exhausted. The evaluation set remains unavailable throughout evolution and is used only afterward in the program-selection procedure described below. Figure 1 illustrates the loop, and Appendix B.1 provides the initialization, search budgets, and execution settings.
blocks.zh: 评价和诊断后,将候选执行,母参考,假说,结果,痕迹,诊断等内容加入档案. 所有被评价的候选人都被保留下来,包括主导性的设计,允许以后的提案重新审视早先的实施,而不是仅仅延长目前最好的方案. 搜索一直持续到概算用完为止。 该评价集在整个演进过程中仍然不可用,只在下文所述的方案选择程序中使用。 图1说明了环路,附录B.1提供了初始化、搜索预算和执行设置。

blocks.en: 2.5 Program Selection
blocks.zh: 2.5 程序选择

blocks.en: After evolution, we shortlist candidates using search-set accuracy for MAPE-A and the search-set accuracy–cost Pareto frontier for MAPE-P , with additional inclusion criteria described in Appendix B.2 . The shortlisted programs are frozen and evaluated on a larger evaluation set that remains inaccessible during evolution. We then inspect their implementations and exclude programs with impractical scaling behavior, such as exhaustive LLM processing of the history during retrieval. For each setting, we report the remaining program with the highest evaluation-set accuracy. The selected programs are denoted MAPE-A LCM , MAPE-P LCM , MAPE-A LME , and MAPE-P LME , where A and P indicate the accuracy-only and joint accuracy–cost search objectives, and LCM and LME denote evolution on LoCoMo and LongMemEval, respectively.
blocks.zh: 进化后,我们采用MAPE-A的搜索设置精准度和MAPE-P的搜索设置精准度-成本Pareto边框,并附加附录B.2所述的纳入标准。 短名单方案被冻结,并按在演变期间仍无法进入的较大评价组进行评价。 然后我们检查其执行,排除不切实际的缩放行为的程序,例如检索过程中对历史进行详尽的LLM处理. 对于每个设定,我们以最高的评价设定精确度报告其余的程序. 选定的程序表示MAPE-A LCM、MAPE-P LCM、MAPE-A LME和MAPE-P LME,其中A和P分别表示精确度和联合精确度-成本搜索目标,LCM和LME表示LoCoMo和LongMemEval上的演变。

blocks.en: 3 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 3 实验设置

blocks.en: We evaluate on LoCoMo ( Maharana et al., 2024 ) and LongMemEval-S ( Wu et al., 2025 ) , using fixed 20% search and 80% evaluation partitions. LoCoMo is split by conversation, while LongMemEval-S is split by question instance together with its associated history. During evolution, candidates are evaluated exclusively on the search partition. The evaluation partition is used afterward for program selection and performance reporting. Appendix C.1 provides the split construction details.
blocks.zh: 我们用固定的20%搜索和80%的评价分区,对LoCoMo(Maharana等人,2024年)和LongMemEval-S(Wu等人,2025年)进行评估。 LoCoMo通过对话而分裂,而LongMemEval-S则通过质询与相关历史一起分裂. 在进化过程中,候选人只接受搜索分区的评价。 评价分区后用于程序选择和绩效报告. 附录C.1提供了拆分施工细节。

blocks.en: We compare against Full Context, which supplies conversation history directly to the QA model, and RAG ( Lewis et al., 2020 ) , which retrieves messages by embedding similarity. We also evaluate five human-designed memory systems: Mem0 ( Chhikara et al., 2025 ) , A-Mem ( Xu et al., 2025 ) , LightMem ( Fang et al., 2025 ) , SimpleMem ( Liu et al., 2026a ) , and Zep ( Rasmussen et al., 2025 ) . Lightweight adapters connect their implementations to the shared evaluation interface without redesigning their memory methods. Appendix C.2 describes the configurations and integration adjustments.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了Full Control,它直接向QA模型提供对话历史,以及RAG(Lewis等人,2020年),它通过嵌入相似性检索消息. 我们还评估了人类设计的五个记忆系统: Mem0(Chhikara等人,2025年),A-Mem(徐等人,2025年),LightMem(Fang等人,2025年),SimpleMem. (刘等人,2026a),和泽普(拉斯穆森等人,2025年). 轻量级适配器在不重新设计内存方法的情况下将其实施与共享评价接口连接起来. 附录C.2描述了配置和整合调整.

blocks.en: We report LoCoMo results with GPT-4.1 mini ( OpenAI, 2025 ) and Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507 ( Yang et al., 2025 ) , and LongMemEval results with Qwen. Cross-benchmark transfer is also evaluated with Qwen. Within each comparison, the serving LLM and QA settings are shared across systems, with text-embedding-3-small as the designated embedding model. GPT-5 mini evaluates answer correctness using benchmark-specific rubrics ( Zheng et al., 2023 ) . We report accuracy pooled across evaluated queries and lifecycle serving cost in dollars per 1,000 queries. Section 2.3 defines the cost aggregation, and Appendix C.3 provides the reporting protocol and model, generation, and pricing details.
blocks.zh: 我们用GPT-4.1(OpenAI,2025年)和Qune3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507(Yang等人,2025年)报告LoCoMo结果,LongMemEval结果与Quen. 跨基准转让也与Quen一同评估. 在每次比较中,服务 LLM 和 QA 设置在系统之间共享,以文本嵌入-3-小作为指定的嵌入模型. GPT-5 迷你评价使用特定基准标点回答正确性(郑等人,2023年). 我们报告,在经过评价的查询和生命周期服务费用中,准确性以每1 000次查询中美元计算。 第2.3节界定了费用汇总,附录C.3提供了报告协议和模式、生成和定价细节。

blocks.en: 4 Results and Analysis
blocks.zh: 4 结果和分析

Retrieve combines dense and sparse rankings through reciprocal rank fusion (RRF) and returns relevant notes and raw conversational evidence. blocks.en: 4.1 Performance Evaluation
blocks.zh: 4.1 考绩

blocks.en: On the LoCoMo evaluation set with GPT-4.1 mini, MAPE-A LCM and MAPE-P LCM achieve overall accuracies of 87.94% and 85.18%, respectively, as shown in Table 1 . MAPE-A LCM outperforms all baselines across every question category, while MAPE-P LCM retains competitive accuracy at approximately 28% of its counterpart’s lifecycle serving cost. On LongMemEval with Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507, MAPE-A LME and MAPE-P LME achieve 77.00% and 72.25% accuracy, respectively, both exceeding RAG, the strongest baseline at 66.00%. MAPE-A LME achieves an absolute accuracy gain of 11.00% over RAG, as shown in Table 2 .
blocks.zh: 如表1所示,在使用GPT-4.1微型、MAPE-A LCM和MAPE-P LCM进行LoCoMo评价时,总体成绩分别为87.94%和85.18%。 MAPE-A LCM的绩效超过了每个问题类别的所有基线,而MAPE-P LCM则保留了竞争力精确度,约为对应方生命周期服务成本的28%。 在LongMemEval上与Qune3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507,MAPE-A LME和MAPE-P LME分别实现77.00%和72.25%的精度,均超过了RAG,最强的基准为66.00%. 如表2所示,MAPE-A LME比RAG的绝对精度增益为11.00%。

blocks.en: Replacing the serving backbone of the LoCoMo-evolved programs, including the QA model, with Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507 preserves strong performance without further evolution. Under this backbone, MAPE-P LCM achieves 81.33% accuracy, an absolute gain of 12.01% over SimpleMem at 35% of its serving cost. The ranking between the two evolved programs reverses, with MAPE-A LCM achieving 78.58%. This reversal is driven by temporal questions: MAPE-A LCM drops from 79.84% to 43.80%, whereas MAPE-P LCM retains 70.93%. MAPE-A LCM leaves the final date-resolution step to the QA model, while MAPE-P LCM explicitly converts relative time expressions into absolute dates before answering, which may help preserve temporal accuracy across backbones. A concrete example is illustrated in Figure 4 .
blocks.zh: 用Qune3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507取代LoCoMo-evolved程序的服务骨干,包括QA模式,保持强性能而无需进一步演化. 在这个主干线下,MAPE-P LCM实现81.33%的精度,绝对收益比SimleMem高12.01%,其服务成本为35%. 两个进化后的节目排名倒转,MAPE-A LCM实现78.58%. 这种逆转是由时间问题驱动的:MAPE-A LCM从79.84%下降到43.80%,而MAPE-P LCM保留了70.93%. MAPE-A LCM将最终的日期分辨率步骤留给QA模型,而MAPE-P LCM在回答前明确将相对时间表达转化为绝对日期,这可能有助于保持跨骨干的时间准确性. 图4说明了具体的例子。

blocks.en: We further evaluate the selected programs on the other benchmark without additional evolution, using the fixed input adapters described in Appendix D.1 . As shown in Table 6 , MAPE-A LCM and MAPE-P LCM achieve 65.50% and 64.25% accuracy on LongMemEval, respectively. Both transferred programs outperform the five evaluated memory systems, while RAG achieves 66.00% accuracy. In the other direction, MAPE-A LME and MAPE-P LME achieve 75.90% and 74.67% accuracy on LoCoMo, respectively, exceeding all baselines in Table 7 . These results support the transferability of the discovered memory designs beyond their search benchmarks, suggesting that their gains are not solely attributable to benchmark-specific adaptation.
blocks.zh: 我们利用附录D.1中描述的固定输入适配器,在不作进一步演变的情况下,进一步评估其他基准上选定的程序。 如表6所示,MAPE-A LCM和MAPE-P LCM在LongMemEval上分别实现了65.50%和64.25%的精度. 两个转移的程序都超过了五个被评价的内存系统,而RAG则实现了66.00%的准确度. 另一方面,MAPE-A LME和MAPE-P LME在LoCoMo的精确度分别为75.90%和74.67%,超过了表7的所有基线。 这些结果支持了所发现的内存设计超出其搜索基准的可转让性,表明其收益并非完全归因于特定基准的适应.

blocks.en: 4.2 Comparing Evolution under Different Objectives
blocks.zh: 4.2 不同目标下的演变比较

blocks.en: The observed runs exhibit different patterns of refinement and exploration. In the illustrated accuracy-only trajectories, search progresses from simple strategies toward increasingly elaborate designs, adding operations to address remaining errors. As accuracy approaches a plateau, further gains come with substantial increases in serving cost. As shown in Figure 5 , introducing per-session note extraction at build time from step 13 increases cost approximately sixfold for additional search accuracy. Figure 6 a illustrates the predominantly additive nature of this process, with successive revisions extending a dominant chain. The illustrated joint accuracy–cost trajectory maintains lower serving costs and exhibits a more branched lineage, as shown in Figure 6 b, exploring alternative designs and removing costly operations. Lower-accuracy candidates can remain nondominated and serve as starting points for subsequent revisions.
blocks.zh: 观测到的运行显示了不同的改进和探索模式。 在仅说明准确性的轨迹中,搜索从简单的战略向越来越细致的设计发展,增加了处理剩余错误的操作. 随着准确性接近高原,服务成本的大幅增加,也带来了进一步的收益。 如图5所示,从第13步开始,在施工时采用每场会议笔记提取法,为增加搜索准确性增加了大约六倍的费用。 图6a说明这一工艺主要具有添加剂的性质,并不断修订,扩展了主导链条。 如图6b所示,说明的联合精度-成本轨迹维持较低的服务成本,并显示更加分支化的分支,探索替代设计并消除成本高昂的业务。 低准确度候选人仍可不受支配,并成为随后修订工作的起点。

blocks.en: The selected programs allocate LLM computation differently across the memory lifecycle. MAPE-A LME extracts atomic notes from each session at build time, which accounts for about 92% of its serving cost. MAPE-A LCM distills facts into speaker profiles and runs a heavier reader over them at query time. Both accuracy–cost designs instead retrieve raw conversation text and compute selectively at query time: MAPE-P LME uses BM25 ( Robertson and Zaragoza, 2009 ) without build-time model calls, and MAPE-P LCM retrieves raw turns and consults extracted facts only for aggregation questions. These designs use 90% and 40% fewer serving calls than their counterparts on LongMemEval and LoCoMo, respectively. The larger reduction on LongMemEval is consistent with its workload: each history serves a single query, so memory construction costs cannot be shared across multiple queries. MAPE-P LME avoids build-time model calls entirely. These programs retain competitive accuracy with fewer serving calls. Despite their differences in computation allocation, the selected designs share the use of raw evidence and query-dependent composition, motivating the component analysis below.
blocks.zh: 所选程序在整个内存生命周期中以不同方式分配LLM计算. MAPE-A LME在构建时间从每个会话中提取原子注释,占其服务成本的约92%. MAPE-A LCM将事实提炼成扬声器简介,并在查询时运行一个比它们更重的阅读器. 精度- 成本设计都取回原始对话文本, 在查询时有选择地计算 : MAPE-P LME使用BM25(Robertson和Zaragoza,2009年),没有构建时的模型调用,MAPE-P LCM检索原始转折,只为汇总问题咨询提取的事实. 这些设计使用的服务电话分别比LongMemEval和LoCoMo的对应电话少90%和40%。 LongMemEval上更大的削减与其工作量一致:每个历史服务于一个单一的查询,因此内存构建成本无法在多个查询中分摊. MAPE-P LME 完全避免构建时模式调用. 这些方案保留了竞争性准确性,服务电话减少。 尽管在计算分配上存在差异,但所选设计共享原始证据的使用和依赖查询的构成,激发了下文的组件分析.

blocks.en: 4.3 Emergent Memory Designs and Component Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.3 紧急内存设计和组件分析

blocks.en: Across the two benchmarks and optimization objectives, the discovered memory systems exhibit two recurring design patterns: retaining raw conversational content and retrieving it as evidence, and routing queries to different composition strategies according to question type. To examine these patterns in detail, we conduct a case study and component analysis of MAPE-A LME , a representative design that incorporates both.
blocks.zh: 在整个两个基准和优化目标中,已发现的内存系统表现出两种反复出现的设计模式:保留原始的对话内容并将其作为证据检索,以及根据问题类型将查询导向不同的组成策略. 为了详细审查这些模式,我们对MAPE-A LME进行了个案研究和组成部分分析,这是一种具有代表性的设计,将两者结合起来。

blocks.en: Figure 2 illustrates the workflow of MAPE-A LME , highlighting two core designs. (1) It organizes memory hierarchically while retaining both extracted and raw evidence. During construction, an LLM extracts atomic notes ( Chen et al., 2024 ) from each session, while the original conversation is preserved as individual rounds; both are jointly indexed using dense and lexical retrieval. At retrieval time, item-level scores are aggregated to rank sessions, and the system returns session-level note bundles alongside up to five highest-ranked raw conversation rounds. (2) Query-Routed Scaffolding (RQS) conditions composition on query type. RQS routes each query by intent and runs an intent-specific scaffold that pairs LLM extraction with deterministic computation, for instance date arithmetic for temporal queries and per-session item extraction followed by programmatic counting for aggregation queries. A final deliberation call applies intent-specific instructions to produce a draft answer, which is passed alongside the evidence to the fixed QA model for final answer generation. Appendix D.5 details the routing and scaffolds.
blocks.zh: 图2说明了MAPE-A LME的工作流程,突出了两个核心设计。 (1) 在保留提取的证据和原始证据的同时,按等级组织记忆。 在构造过程中,一个LLM从每个会话中提取原子注释(Chen et al., 2024),而原始的谈话则作为单个回合保存;两者都使用密集和词典检索法共同索引. 在检索时,项目级的分数被汇总到排序会话,系统返回会话级的音符捆绑,与最多五个排名最高的原始对话回合并列. (2)查询-鲁特脚手架(RQS)在查询类型上的条件构成. RQS按意向引导每个查询,并运行一个针对特定意图的脚手架,将LLM提取与确定性计算相配,例如时间查询的日期算法和每次会议项提取,然后对汇总查询进行程序计数。 最终审议呼吁采用针对意图的指令来生成一个答案草稿,该答案草稿与证据一起传递给固定的QA模型,用于最终答案生成. 附录D.5详细介绍了路线和脚手架.

blocks.zh: 图3:RQS从MAPE-A LME移植到人类设计的5个内存系统中,在以Qune3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507为服务骨干进行的LongMemEval评价集上评价. 粗体值表示绝对精度增益%.

blocks.en: First, we examine how retaining and retrieving raw conversations affects overall performance. We remove the retrieved raw rounds from the answer context while retaining them in the index and leaving the remaining pipeline unchanged. This reduces accuracy by an absolute 12.17% on LoCoMo and 6.50% on LongMemEval, as shown in Table 3 . The largest decline on LongMemEval occurs for single-session-assistant questions, where accuracy drops by an absolute 20.00%. Category-level results are provided in Table 8 in Appendix D.3 . These results highlight the importance of raw conversations for recovering details omitted from extracted memories. In contrast, all five evaluated human-designed memory systems discard the original conversations after extracting facts during construction or omit them from the evidence provided to the QA model. This can leave the QA model without fine-grained semantic information needed for subsequent questions. Our error attribution analysis identifies incomplete retrieved evidence as a major source of errors in these systems. Estimated evidence completeness is strongly positively associated with overall accuracy. Appendix D.4 details the estimation procedure and an additional analysis of incorrect answers, with results shown in Figures 7 and 8 .
blocks.zh: 首先,我们审查保留和检索原始对话如何影响总体业绩。 我们从回答语境中去掉回收的生弹,同时保留在索引中,其余的管道保持不变。 如表3所示,在LoCoMo和LongMemEval的精确度分别下降12.17%和6.50%。 LongMemEval的下降幅度最大的是单会次助理问题,准确度下降绝对为20.00 %. 类别一级的结果见附录D.3表8。 这些结果突出了原始对话对于恢复从提取的记忆中遗漏的细节的重要性。 相比之下,所有5个评价人设计的内存系统在构造过程中提取事实或从提供给QA模型的证据中忽略了原始对话. 这可以让QA模型没有后续问题所需的精细的语义信息. 我们的错误归属分析发现,不完全检索的证据是这些系统中错误的主要来源。 估计证据的完整性与总体准确性密切相关。 附录D.4详细介绍了估算程序和对错误答案的补充分析,结果见图7和图8。

blocks.en: We next evaluate the effectiveness and transferability of RQS. We compare RQS with default evidence rendering using the same recorded retrieval and fixed QA settings. Removing RQS from MAPE-A LME reduces accuracy by an absolute 4.44% on LoCoMo and 6.25% on LongMemEval, with the largest declines on temporal questions, as shown in Tables 8 and 9 . This finding is consistent with the difficulties in temporal reasoning and counting identified by the proposer and diagnosis agents during evolution with both GPT-4.1 mini and Qwen backbones. RQS addresses these failure modes by combining LLM-based extraction with deterministic computation ( Gao et al., 2023 ; Chen et al., 2023 ) . The separation of composition from memory construction and retrieval further allows us to transplant RQS into five human-designed memory systems through a fixed input adapter. Across the five systems, RQS yields absolute accuracy gains of 2.75–9.25% on LongMemEval under the paired evaluation protocol, as shown in Figure 3 . Mem0 shows the smallest improvement, at 2.75%. Our error analysis suggests that its failures are dominated by missing retrieved information, whereas RQS primarily addresses cases in which sufficient evidence is available but the QA model fails to identify or use it effectively.
blocks.zh: 我们接下来评价RQS的有效性和可转让性。 我们用相同的记录检索和固定的QA设置来比较RQS和默认证据渲染. 从MAPE-A LME中去除RQS后,LoCoMo的精度下降绝对4.44%,LongMemEval的精度下降6.25%,时间问题下降幅度最大,见表8和9。 这一结论与提议者和诊断人员在GPT-4.1小型骨干和Quen骨干进化过程中发现的时间推理和计数方面的困难是一致的。 RQS通过将基于LLM的提取与确定性计算相结合来解决这些故障模式(Gao等人,2023年;Chen等人,2023年)。 从内存构建和检索中分离成份,进一步使我们能够通过固定输入适配器将RQS移植到人类设计的五个内存系统中. 如图3所示,在五个系统中,RQS在RongMemEval上根据配对评价协议的绝对精度收益为2.75-9.25%。 Mem0显示的改善最小,为2.75%. 我们的错误分析表明,其失败主要是缺失检索到的信息,而RQS主要处理的是有充足证据但QA模型未能有效识别或使用的情况。

blocks.en: 5 Related Work
blocks.zh: 5 相关工作

blocks.en: Agent memory systems organize interaction histories through reflection, selective updates, and hierarchical storage, as exemplified by Generative Agents, MemoryBank, and MemGPT ( Park et al., 2023 ; Zhong et al., 2024 ; Packer et al., 2023 ) . Mem0 extracts and consolidates memories ( Chhikara et al., 2025 ) , while Zep and A-Mem organize them through temporal knowledge graphs and linked networks, respectively ( Rasmussen et al., 2025 ; Xu et al., 2025 ) . LightMem combines topic-based organization with offline consolidation ( Fang et al., 2025 ) . SimpleMem combines semantic compression with intent-aware retrieval ( Liu et al., 2026a ) . Mem0, Zep, A-Mem, LightMem, and SimpleMem serve as baselines in our empirical analysis.
blocks.zh: 代理内存系统通过反射,选择性更新和分级存储来组织互动历史,例如Generative Agents, MemoryBank,和MemGPT(Park等人,2023年;Zhong等人,2024年;Packer等人,2023年). Mem0提取和巩固记忆(Chhikara等人,2025年),而Zep和A-Mem分别通过时间知识图和链接网络组织记忆(Rasmussen等人,2025年;徐等人,2025年). LightMem将基于主题的组织与离线合并结合起来(Fang等人,2025年). 简单 Mem将语义压缩与意向意识检索相结合(Liu等人,2026a). Mem0,Zep,A-Mem,LightMem,和SimpleMem作为我们经验分析的基线.

blocks.en: Prior work has explored preserving conversational histories and processing evidence after retrieval. CoM combines lightweight memory construction with query-oriented organization of retrieved fragments into inference chains ( Xu et al., 2026 ) . CoM also informs our inclusion of a programmable composition stage. DeferMem and LazyMem shift evidence processing to query time, using learned models to produce relevant evidence from retrieved histories ( Yin et al., 2026 ; Yu et al., 2026 ) . ReFind instead enables an agent to search raw conversation logs directly ( Li et al., 2026 ) . These approaches differ in whether they primarily improve access to evidence or transform retrieved evidence for answering.
blocks.zh: 以前的工作探索了保存对话历史和在检索后处理证据。 COM将轻量级内存构建与面向查询的组织,将回收的碎片组织到推论链中(徐等人,2026年). CM还告知我们包含一个可编程组成阶段. DeferMem和LazyMem将证据处理转移到查询时间,利用学到的模型从检索的历史中产生相关证据(Yin等人,2026年;Yu等人,2026年)。 ReFind则让代理直接搜索原始对话日志(Li等人,2026年). 这些办法在是主要改善获取证据的机会,还是将收回的证据转换为回答方面有所不同。

blocks.en: Recent empirical studies further examine the value of memory construction relative to raw-history retrieval. Raw-RAG demonstrates the competitiveness of dense retrieval and reranking over raw histories ( Bao et al., 2026 ) . Memory Tax distinguishes the benefits of memory transformation from losses caused by removing or obscuring useful evidence ( He et al., 2026 ) . These findings provide complementary evidence for the importance of preserving and accessing source information. MAPE examines memory design choices through program evolution and evaluates the resulting components through ablation and transplantation. Its query-routed scaffolding combines intent-specific evidence processing with deterministic computation and deliberation.
blocks.zh: 最近的经验研究进一步考察了记忆构造相对于原始历史检索的价值. Raw-RAG显示了密集检索的竞争力,并重排在原始历史之上(Bao等人,2026年)。 记忆税区分了内存转换的好处与去除或混淆有用证据造成的损失(He等人,2026年). 这些调查结果提供了补充证据,说明维护和获取来源信息的重要性。 MAPE通过程序进化来审查内存设计选择,并通过衰减和移植来评价由此产生的组件. 其查询路线的脚手架将特定意图的证据处理与决定性的计算和审议结合起来.

blocks.en: MetaMem evolves knowledge-utilization guidance ( Xin et al., 2026 ) . MemTrace uses attribution of failures across memory operations to guide prompt optimization ( Deng et al., 2026 ) , while EvolveMem adapts retrieval and answer-generation configurations ( Liu et al., 2026b ) . MemEvolve jointly evolves experiential knowledge and memory architectures within a modular design space ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) . At the level of agent capabilities, Mem 2 Evolve couples experience distillation with the creation of reusable tools and expert agents ( Cheng et al., 2026 ) . MemPro extends this direction to system-level evolution, treating memory construction–retrieval pipelines as executable programs subject to failure-guided revision ( Liu et al., 2026c ) . MemScope uses execution traces and runtime memory state to guide localized code repairs to an existing memory architecture ( Su et al., 2026 ) . These studies span the evolution of stored experience, reusable capabilities, and memory system code. MAPE starts from minimal seeds and permits coordinated changes across memory construction, retrieval, and composition. By comparing accuracy-only and joint accuracy–cost objectives, we examine how search objectives shape memory designs and the allocation of computation across stages. Beyond evaluating the resulting programs, we use component ablations and transplantation across existing memory systems to assess which design choices contribute to their effectiveness and transfer beyond the evolved implementation.
blocks.zh: MetaMem演化知识利用指导(Xin等人,2026年). MemTrace使用跨内存操作失败的归属来指导即时优化(Deng等人,2026年),而EvolveMem则调整检索和答案生成配置(Liu等人,2026年b). MemEvolve在模块化设计空间内联合演化实验性知识和内存架构(张等,2026). 在代理能力层面,Mem 2 Evolve夫妇通过创建可重复使用的工具和专家代理进行蒸馏(Cheng等人,2026年)。 MemPro将这一方向延伸至系统层面的演化,将内存构造-检索管道作为可执行程序,但需进行故障制导修改(Liu等人,2026c). MemScope使用执行跟踪和运行时间内存状态来引导本地化代码修复一个现有的内存架构(Su et al., 2026) . 这些研究跨越了存储经验的演变,可重复使用的能力,以及内存系统代码. MAPE从最低限度的种子开始,并允许在内存构造、检索和组成方面协调变化。 通过比较精确度和共同精确度-成本目标,我们审查搜索目标如何塑造内存设计和各阶段的计算分配。 除了评价由此产生的方案外,我们还利用现有记忆系统中的组件拼接和移植来评估哪些设计选择有助于其效力和转移,超越已演变的实施。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We introduced MAPE to study agent memory design through whole-program evolution from minimal seeds. Across two benchmarks, the evolved programs instantiate two recurring design patterns: retaining raw conversations as retrievable evidence and processing retrieved evidence through intent-specific scaffolds before answering. Ablations highlight the value of preserving raw evidence, while transplanting the evolved composition module improves all five evaluated human-designed systems. Under the evaluated workloads, incorporating serving cost into the search objective favors selective query-time processing over LLM-based memory construction, while retaining competitive accuracy. Together, these findings illustrate how program evolution, combined with component analysis and transplantation, can produce effective memory systems and empirically grounded design lessons.
blocks.zh: 我们引进了MAPE来研究代理记忆设计 通过从最小种子的全程进化. 在整个两个基准中,演化出来的程序将两个反复出现的设计模式即时化:保留原始对话作为可检索的证据,通过特定意图的脚手架在回答之前处理回收的证据. 缩写突出了保存原始证据的价值,而移植进化的成分模块则改善了所有五个被评价的人设计的系统. 根据所评估的工作量,将服务费用纳入搜索目标有利于选择性查询时间处理,而不是基于LLM的内存构建,同时保持竞争性准确性。 这些研究结果共同说明了程序进化,结合组件分析和移植,如何产生有效的内存系统以及实证化的设计教训.

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: Our findings concern conversational memory on two QA benchmarks, with detailed component analysis centered on one representative program. Transfer and transplantation experiments extend the evaluation across models, benchmarks, and memory systems, while applicability to experiential memory and open-ended agents remains to be established. Evolutionary trajectories and resulting programs can vary across runs, and program selection and design interpretation involve empirical judgment. Our cost comparisons cover serving token charges for LLM and embedding calls, excluding search expenses, local computation, and latency. Their implications depend on workload, particularly how memory construction costs are amortized across queries.
blocks.zh: 我们的调查结果涉及两个质量保证基准的对话记忆,详细的组成部分分析集中在一个具有代表性的方案上。 转让和移植实验将评价扩展到模型、基准和内存系统,而适用于经验内存和无限制物剂则有待确定。 进化轨迹和由此产生的程序可以跨运行而变化,程序选择和设计解释涉及经验判断. 我们的费用比较包括LLM和嵌入式呼叫的象征性收费,不包括搜索费用、当地计算和延迟。 其影响取决于工作量,特别是内存建造费用如何在各种查询中摊销。

blocks.en: Appendix B Evolutionary Search Details
blocks.zh: 附录B 搜索细节

blocks.en: B.1 Search Configuration
blocks.zh: B.1 搜索配置

blocks.en: MAPE-P is initialized with no-memory and full-context seeds, representing minimal memory overhead and unrestricted access to conversation history, respectively. These seeds provide contrasting starting points for exploring the trade-off between accuracy and cost. MAPE-A starts only from the no-memory seed to reduce architectural anchoring on full-context inference and encourage exploration beyond incremental revisions to that design.
blocks.zh: MAPE-P初始化时采用无记忆种子和满文种子,分别代表最小的内存上层和不受限制的接触对话历史. 这些种子为探讨准确性和成本之间的权衡提供了对比性的起点。 MAPE-A只从无记忆种子开始,以减少建筑在完整文字推论上的锚定,并鼓励在对设计进行增量修改之外进行探索。

blocks.en: We perform three evolutionary runs per setting on LoCoMo and one per setting on LongMemEval. Each run consists of 20 steps, with one candidate program proposed at each step.
blocks.zh: 我们在LoCoMo上进行三次进化运行,在LongMemEval上进行一次进化运行。 每次竞选共20步,每步都提出一个候选方案.

blocks.en: Before full evaluation, each proposed candidate undergoes a sanity check using three questions from one search conversation on LoCoMo or two search instances on LongMemEval. If the check fails, the proposer receives the error trace and can repair the program up to twice, with a new check after each repair. Candidates that still fail are not evaluated on the full search set. Candidates that pass are evaluated on the entire search partition without progressive filtering or resampling between steps. Each proposer invocation allows up to 80 agent turns and 45 minutes, while each diagnosis invocation allows up to 40 turns and 30 minutes.
blocks.zh: 在充分评价之前,每个被提名的候选人都要通过LoCoMo上的一个搜索对话或LongMemEval上的两个搜索实例中的三个问题进行理智检查。 如果检查失败,提议者会收到错误追踪,并可以修复最多两次的程序,每次修复后再进行新的检查. 仍然失败的候选人不会在全搜索集上评价. 在整个搜索分区上对通过考试的候选人进行评价,而不在台阶之间进行渐进过滤或重新取样。 每个提议方的引用时间可长达80个代理回合和45分钟,而每个诊断引用时间可长达40个代理回合和30分钟。

blocks.en: MAPE-P jointly optimizes QA accuracy and lifecycle serving cost as two separate objectives. The proposer uses the accuracy–cost Pareto frontier to guide candidate generation. MAPE-A optimizes QA accuracy alone.
blocks.zh: MAPE-P联合优化了质量评估的准确性和生命周期服务成本,作为两个单独的目标. 提议者使用准确性-成本的Pareto边框来指导候选人的产生。 MAPE-A仅优化QA精度.

blocks.en: Both the proposer and diagnosis agents use Claude Opus 4.8 with reasoning effort set to xhigh throughout the evolutionary loop. During search, GPT-4.1 mini serves as the backbone for both LLM-based memory operations and QA generation on LoCoMo, while Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507 serves these roles on LongMemEval. We use text-embedding-3-small for all embedding calls across both benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 提议者和诊断剂都使用克劳德·奥普斯4.8,其推理努力设定在整个进化循环中达到x高. 在搜索过程中,GPT-4.1迷你作为LLM基于内存操作和LoCoMo上的QA生成的骨干,而Qune3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507则在LongMemEval上服务这些角色. 我们对所有贯穿两个基准的嵌入调用都使用文本嵌入-3-小调。

blocks.en: B.2 Program Selection
blocks.zh: B.2 方案选择

blocks.en: For MAPE-A , we shortlist the top 20% of candidates ranked by search-set accuracy. For MAPE-P , we shortlist all candidates on the search-set accuracy–cost Pareto frontier. Each shortlist additionally includes the program with the most direct children in that run’s lineage, if it is not already included. On LoCoMo, we pool the shortlists from the three runs within each setting before final selection. Shortlisted programs are frozen and evaluated on the larger evaluation set, which remains unavailable throughout evolution.
blocks.zh: 对于MAPE-A,我们以搜索的精确度排在排名前20%的候选人名单中。 对MAPE-P来说, 每份短名单中,如果未包括的话,还包括与该营系中最直接的儿童有关的方案。 在LoCoMo上,我们把三个人的短名单放在每个场合内,然后再进行最后挑选。 短名单方案被冻结,在更大的评价组上进行评价,在整个演变过程中,这些评价组一直没有。

blocks.en: After evaluation, we manually inspect the shortlisted implementations and exclude programs with impractical scaling behavior, such as reliance on full-history inference or exhaustive LLM-based processing of the history during retrieval. For each setting, we report the remaining program with the highest evaluation-set accuracy. The evaluation set is thus used for final selection, but provides no feedback for program evolution.
blocks.zh: 经过评价后,我们手动检查了短名单的执行,并排除了不切实际的缩放行为的程序,例如依赖完整历史推论,或在检索过程中对历史进行详尽的LLM处理. 对于每个设定,我们以最高的评价设定精确度报告其余的程序. 因此,评价集被用于最终选择,但没有为程序演化提供反馈.

blocks.en: Appendix C Experimental Setup Details
blocks.zh: 附录C 设置细节

blocks.en: C.1 Data Splits
blocks.zh: C.1 数据分割

blocks.en: We use fixed, disjoint search and evaluation partitions. The evaluation partition remains unavailable during evolution and is subsequently used for final program selection and performance reporting. The 20/80 allocation applies to conversations in LoCoMo and question instances in LongMemEval.
blocks.zh: 我们使用固定的、脱节的搜索和评估分区。 在演变过程中,评价分区仍然无法使用,随后被用于最终方案选择和业绩报告。 20/80分配适用于LoCoMo的谈话和LongMemEval的提问。

blocks.en: The dataset contains ten conversations. Following the implementation’s fixed file order, we use the first two, conv-26 and conv-30 , for search and the remaining eight for evaluation. Adversarial questions are excluded before evaluation. This yields 233 search questions and 1,307 evaluation questions. Table 4 reports the resulting counts, including the excluded questions for completeness.
blocks.zh: 数据集包含10个对话. 根据执行的固定文件命令,我们使用头两个文件(conv-26和conv-30)进行搜索,其余八个用于评估。 在评价前排除了难题。 这产生了233个搜索问题和1 307个评价问题。 表4报告了结果的清点,包括排除的完整问题。

blocks.en: Table 4: LoCoMo partition sizes. Questions inherit the partition of their conversation; adversarial questions are excluded from evaluation.
blocks.zh: 表4: LoCoMo分区大小. 问题继承了他们谈话的分化;对抗性问题被排除在评价之外。

blocks.en: We use LongMemEval-S, which contains 500 question instances with associated conversation histories. We allocate 100 instances for search and 400 for evaluation, using stratified sampling across the six question types to maintain an approximately 20/80 split within each type. Within each question type, we sort question IDs and shuffle them with a shared Python random generator initialized with the fixed seed longmemeval.search.v1 , processing types in sorted order. Search counts are allocated proportionally, with remaining slots assigned to the largest fractional remainders and ties resolved by type name. The remaining instances form the evaluation partition. Table 5 reports the resulting distribution.
blocks.zh: 我们使用LongMemEval-S,其中包含500个与相关对话历史相关的问题实例. 我们分配100例用于搜索,400例用于评价,利用六类问题的分层抽样,在每种类型中保持大约20/80分数。 在每个问题类型中,我们用一个共享的 Python 随机生成器对ID进行排序,并用固定种子 longmeval.search.v1 初始化,按排序顺序处理类型. 搜索数按比例分配,其余的插槽分配到分数最多的剩余部分,并按类型名称解决链接. 其余情况构成评价分区。 表5报告了结果的分布情况。

blocks.en: Table 5: LongMemEval-S question counts under the fixed stratified partition. Each question and its associated history are assigned together.
blocks.zh: 表5:LongMemEval -- 问题在固定分层分区下计数。 每个问题及其相关历史都被一并分配.

blocks.en: C.2 Baselines and Implementations
blocks.zh: C.2 基线和执行

blocks.en: We reuse the baseline memory implementations through adapters that connect their construction and retrieval APIs to our standardized evaluation interface. The adapters map benchmark histories to each method’s expected input format and return retrieved evidence to the shared QA model. Answer generation and judging follow the common benchmark protocol, with isolated memory state for each evaluation instance. Key configurations and integration adjustments are summarized below.
blocks.zh: 我们通过适配器重新使用基线内存执行,这些适配器将其构建和检索API与我们的标准化评价接口连接起来. 适配器将基准历史映射到每种方法的预期输入格式,并将检索到的证据返回到共享的质量保证模型中。 答案生成和判断遵循共同的基准协议,每个评价实例都有孤立的内存状态. 关键配置和整合调整概述如下.

blocks.en: Full Context supplies the conversation history within a 128,000-token budget, retaining the most recent messages in chronological order when truncation is needed. RAG retrieves the top-10 messages by embedding cosine similarity, preserving timestamps and speaker information, without query rewriting or reranking.
blocks.zh: 完整背景在128 000个数据库的预算范围内提供对话历史,在需要缩短时按时间顺序保留最新消息。 RAG通过嵌入余弦相似度,保存时间戳和扬声器信息,不进行查询重写或重新排位来获取顶级10位消息.

blocks.en: Mem0 uses batches of 20 messages for fact extraction and retrieves the top-10 facts with a threshold of 0.0. A-Mem retrieves the top-10 notes with linked-memory expansion. LightMem enables LLMlingua-2 compression and segmentation, uses user_only messages and flat extraction, performs offline updates, and retrieves the top-20 memories. Its compression rate, extraction threshold, and update similarity threshold are 0.6, 0.1, and 0.9, respectively. SimpleMem uses 20-message windows with a two-message overlap, retrieval limits of 25, 5, and 5 for semantic, keyword, and structured search, and query planning with up to two reflection rounds. Zep uses Graphiti with retrieval limits of 20 for facts and entity summaries and bge-reranker-v2-m3 reranking.
blocks.zh: Mem0使用批量20条信息进行事实提取,并检索最高10个事实,阈值为0.0. A-Mem通过链接-Memary扩展来检索前十名的音符. LightMem 启用 LLMlingua-2 压缩和分割,使用用户_只使用信件和平面提取,进行离线更新,并检索上20个记忆. 其压缩率,提取阈值,以及更新的相似性阈值分别为0.6,0.1和0.9. SimpleMem使用20个消息窗口,双消息重叠,检索限制为25,5和5,用于语义,关键词,以及结构化的搜索,以及最多两轮反射的查询规划. Zep使用Graphiti,对事实和实体摘要的检索限制为20,bge-reranker-v2-m3重排.

blocks.en: The integration layer handles model compatibility, usage accounting, and runtime error handling. Mem0 embedding inputs are truncated to 7,800 tokens when necessary; fact extraction still receives the full message batch. Mem0 and SimpleMem use minimal package initializers. Zep uses FalkorDB Lite instead of Neo4j, changing the storage and full-text search backend. These adjustments do not constitute a redesign of the baseline memory methods.
blocks.zh: 集成层处理模型兼容性,使用核算,运行时间错误处理. Mem0嵌入式输入在必要的时候被切换到7800个符;事实提取仍然收到完整的消息批次. Mem0和SimleMem使用最小的包初始化器. Zep使用FalkorDB Lite代替Neo4j,改变存储和全文搜索后端. 这些调整并不构成基线内存方法的重新设计。

blocks.en: C.3 Models and Evaluation Details
blocks.zh: C.3 模式和评价细节

blocks.en: We use GPT-4.1 mini and Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507 as serving backbones for evaluation-set comparisons. Within each setting, the designated backbone handles both LLM-based memory operations and answer generation, and text-embedding-3-small provides embeddings. Qwen is served locally on eight NVIDIA H100 GPUs. Selected programs and baselines share the same designated models and benchmark-specific answering procedure. The QA prompt templates are provided in Appendix E.1 .
blocks.zh: 我们使用GPT-4.1微型和Qune3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507作为评价-设定比较的骨干. 在每一个设置中,指定的骨干既处理基于LLM的内存操作,又处理答案生成,文本嵌入-3-小提供嵌入. Quen在当地服务于八台NVIDIA H100 GPU. 部分程序和基线共享相同的指定模式和特定基准的回答程序. 质量保证即时模板见附录E.1。

blocks.en: GPT-5 mini judges each predicted answer against the ground-truth answer using the benchmark-specific rubric. For reported benchmark results, we pool the resulting binary correctness judgments across all evaluated queries to obtain overall accuracy. The judge prompt templates are provided in Appendix E.2 . Reported accuracy gains and drops are absolute differences.
blocks.zh: GPT-5小型法官每人使用具体基准标题根据地面真相答复预测答案。 对于报告的基准结果,我们汇集了所有经评价的查询中得出的二进制正确性判断,以获得总体准确性。 法官的即时模板见附录E.2。 报告的准确度增减是绝对差异.

blocks.en: The shared QA wrapper sets a completion limit of 16,384 tokens and leaves temperature, top-p, and the generation seed unspecified, using API or serving defaults. Calls within memory programs can override wrapper defaults. The GPT-5 mini judge uses low reasoning effort and a 16,384-token completion limit. If a length-limit error occurs without visible output, the judge retries once with a 32,768-token limit.
blocks.zh: 共享的QA包装器设定了16,384个令牌的完成限值,并使用API或服务默认值,将温度,顶p,生成种子未指定. 内存程序中的呼叫可以覆盖包默认值. GPT-5型迷你裁判采用低推理能力以及16,384个托肯完成极限. 如果一个长度限制错误在没有可见输出的情况下发生,法官用32,768个托肯限制重试一次.

blocks.en: We record LLM input, LLM output, and embedding token usage across build, retrieve, compose, and answer, and apply the corresponding per-token prices of the designated models. Following § 2.3 , we amortize the total cost over the answered queries for each history and take an unweighted mean across histories, reporting dollars per 1,000 queries. Judge and search-agent calls, general-purpose computation, and storage are excluded.
blocks.zh: 我们记录 LLM 输入, LLM 输出, 以及嵌入符号使用 跨构建, 检索, 编曲, 并回答, 并应用指定的模型的相应每盘价格 。 依据第2.3节,我们将每个历史中答复的询问的费用总额摊还,并采用未经加权的平均数,每1 000次询问报告美元。 法官和搜索代理电话、一般用途计算和存储不包括在内。

blocks.en: We use fixed rates from our pricing configuration dated 21 September 2026, based on OpenAI 1 1 1 https://openai.com/api/pricing/ and Alibaba Cloud Model Studio 2 2 2 https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/model-studio/model-pricing list prices. The rates below are in USD per million tokens.
blocks.zh: 根据OpenAI 1 1 1 https://openai.com/api/pricing/和阿里巴巴云模型工作室 2 2 2 https://www.alibabacloud.com/ help/en/model-studio/model-pricing list price story. 以下费率为每百万令牌美元。

blocks.en: Model Input Output GPT-4.1 mini 0.40 1.60 Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507 0.20 0.80 text-embedding-3-small 0.02 —

For each call, we multiply input and output token counts by their respective rates and divide by one million. Embedding calls incur only the input charge. We apply no cached input discounts. Although Qwen runs locally, we value its token usage at the corresponding API rates. Reported costs therefore estimate serving cost at these fixed rates rather than actual infrastructure expenditure.
blocks.zh: 每一次通话,我们都会将输入值和产出值乘以各自的比率,除以100万。 嵌入式通话只需输入充电. 我们没有执行缓存输入折扣。 虽然Quen在本地运行,但我们以相应的API费率来估价其象征性使用. 因此,报告的费用按这些固定费率而不是实际基础设施支出估算服务费用。

blocks.zh: 附录D 结果和分析

blocks.en: D.1 Cross-Benchmark Transfer
blocks.zh: D.1 双倍标记转让

blocks.en: We evaluate the selected programs on the other benchmark without further evolution, using Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507 as the serving backbone. Tables 6 and 7 report transfer from LoCoMo to LongMemEval and vice versa. Fixed input adapters reconcile the conversation formats before memory construction and retrieval, leaving the evolved code unchanged. QA, judging, embeddings, and cost accounting follow the target benchmark’s evaluation protocol.
blocks.zh: 我们利用Qune3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507作为服务骨干,在另一个基准上评价选定的程序,而无需进一步演变. 表6和表7报告从LoCoMo转到LongMemEval,反之亦然。 固定输入适配器在内存构建和检索前调节对话格式,使进化的代码保持不变. 质量保证、判断、嵌入和成本核算遵循目标基准的评价协议。

blocks.en: The adapter converts each dated user–assistant session into the two-speaker format expected by the LoCoMo programs. It preserves session and message order, reformats dates, and maps message roles to the speakers User and Assistant .
blocks.zh: 适配器将每个日期的用户- 助手会话转换为 LoCoMo 程序所期望的双语调格式 。 它保存会话和消息顺序,重排日期,并将消息角色映射给演讲者用户和助理.

No question date is supplied because LoCoMo does not provide one.

blocks.en: The temporal errors under backbone transfer help explain the ranking reversal reported in Section 4.1 . MAPE-A LCM annotates relative time expressions with the conversation date, whereas MAPE-P LCM resolves them to absolute dates. Under Qwen, 134 of the former’s 145 temporal errors return a conversation date rather than the event date. A concrete example is illustrated in Figure 4 .

blocks.en: D.3 Raw Conversation Rounds in MAPE-A LME
blocks.zh: D.3 原始对话 MAPE-A LME中回合数

blocks.en: MAPE-A LME returns extracted atomic notes alongside five retrieved raw conversation rounds, each consisting of a user message and the replies that follow it. To assess the contribution of raw evidence, we remove these rounds from the returned evidence while retaining them in the index and session scoring. All other components are kept unchanged. LoCoMo evaluation uses the fixed input adapter described in Appendix D.1 .
blocks.zh: MAPE-A LME 返回提取的原子注释,同时进行5轮提取的原始对话,每轮由用户信件和随附的回复组成. 为了评估原始证据的贡献,我们将这些轮次从退回的证据中删除,同时将其保留在索引和会话评分中。 所有其他组件保持不变。 LoCoMo评价使用附录D.1所述的固定输入适配器.

blocks.zh: 表8:LongMemEval上MAPE-A LME的组件与Qune3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507服务骨干,提供了表3的提问类型细分. 粗体行表示整个系统. W/o生弹从返回的证据中省略了5个检索到的谈话回合,同时将其保留在索引中;w/o RQS绕过组成并使用默认证据渲染;w/o两者都同时适用allication. 数值为%, 在所有问题中计算。 栏缩略语见表2。

Results provide the question-type breakdown of Table 3 . The bold row denotes the full system; ablation definitions follow Table 8 . Values are accuracies in %, with Avg computed over all questions. Column abbreviations follow Table 1 .

blocks.en: Removing raw rounds reduces overall accuracy by 6.50% on LongMemEval and 12.17% on LoCoMo, as shown in Tables 8 and 9 . The largest decline on LongMemEval occurs for single-session-assistant questions. On LoCoMo, accuracy decreases across all categories, with the largest declines on temporal and single-hop questions. These results support providing raw conversational evidence alongside extracted notes.
blocks.zh: 如表8和表9所示,移除生弹使LongMemEval和LoCoMo的总精度分别降低6.50%和12.17%。 LongMemEval的下降幅度最大的是单场辅助问题。 在LoCoMo上,准确度在所有类别中都下降,在时间和单跳问题上下降幅度最大. 这些结果支持提供原始的谈话证据以及提取的笔记.

blocks.en: D.4 Retrieval Completeness and Error Attribution
blocks.zh: D.4 检索完整性和误差归属

blocks.en: Figure 7: Evidence completeness among incorrect answers with the Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507 serving backbone. Panels a and b show LongMemEval and LoCoMo, respectively. blocks.en: D.5 Query-Routed Scaffolding: Design, Ablation, and Transplant
blocks.zh: D.5 查询-露天脚手架:设计、安装和移植

blocks.en: Query-Routed Scaffolding (RQS) implements the compose stage of MAPE-A LME , as shown in Figure 2 . It processes retrieved evidence through three steps: routing, scaffolding, and deliberation.
blocks.zh: 如图2所示,Query-Routed脚手架(RQS)执行MAPE-A LME的编曲阶段。 它通过三个步骤处理收集的证据:路线、脚手架和审议。

blocks.en: Route. Rules based on the query wording assign each question to one of six intents: temporal, aggregation, difference, current-value, preference, or direct lookup. The assigned intent determines the subsequent processing strategy.
blocks.zh: 路线 基于查询措辞的规则将每个问题分配给六个意图中的一个:时间、汇总、差异、当前值、偏好或直接查询。 指定的意图决定了后续的处理策略.

blocks.en: Scaffold. For temporal questions, the scaffold extracts event dates and explicitly stated durations. It anchors relative expressions such as “last week” to the relevant session date and resolves them through date arithmetic. For aggregation questions, it extracts matching items from each session, removes duplicates, and counts or sums the items in code. Two independent extraction passes are compared. If they disagree, both item lists are retained for deliberation. Difference questions use extracted values for programmatic subtraction, while current-value questions select the most recently dated value. Preference questions use relevant user details to guide personalised responses. Direct lookups proceed to deliberation without a specialised computational scaffold.
blocks.zh: 脚手架. 对于时间问题,脚手架提取事件日期和明确注明的期限. 它将“上周”等相对表达方式固定在有关届会日期,并按日期算出。 对于汇总问题,它从每个会话中提取匹配项目,删除重复,并计数或汇总代码中的项目. 比较了两张独立提取通行证。 如果双方不同意,则保留两个项目清单供审议。 差异问题使用提取值进行程序减值,而当前值问题选择最近的日期值。 首选问题使用相关用户细节指导个性化回应. 直接检查在没有专门的计算脚手架的情况下开始进行审议。

blocks.en: Deliberate. A single LLM call applies intent-specific instructions to the scaffold outputs and retrieved evidence, with session notes ordered chronologically. The resulting reasoning and supporting quote are combined with the evidence in the composed context and passed to the shared QA model for final answer generation. Deliberation can revise scaffold outputs against the evidence. All LLM calls within RQS use the designated serving backbone, which also performs QA. The QA model and answering prompt are held fixed across compared systems.
blocks.zh: 精心谋划. 单次LLM呼叫对脚手架输出和检索到的证据适用特定意图指示,按时间顺序排列会话笔记. 由此产生的推理和佐证引文与构成语境中的证据结合,并传递给共享的QA模型,用于最终解答生成. 审议可以根据证据修改脚手架输出。 RQS内部的所有LLM呼叫都使用指定的服务骨干,这也履行QA. 质评模型和答题即时被固定在比较系统中。

blocks.en: We isolate the contribution of RQS by replaying the same recorded retrieval for each paired comparison. Memory construction, retrieved evidence, and QA settings are held fixed. The ablation compares the full system with a variant that replaces RQS with the benchmark’s default evidence rendering. We evaluate MAPE-A LME on LongMemEval and on LoCoMo through the fixed input adapter described in Appendix D.1 .
blocks.zh: 我们通过对每对比较重放相同的记录检索来隔离RQS的贡献. 内存构建,检索到的证据,以及QA设置被固定. 衰减用一个变体来比较整个系统,用基准的默认证据渲染来取代RQS. 我们在LongMemEval和LoCoMo上通过附录D.1所述的固定输入适配器对MAPE-A LME进行评估。

blocks.en: We apply the same RQS module to SimpleMem, LightMem, A-Mem, Zep, and Mem0 while retaining each system’s memory construction and retrieval. A fixed adapter maps retrieved memory units to notes, groups them by available dates, and removes exact duplicates within each group. Method-specific fields are normalized to this common representation; units without temporal metadata are placed in an undated session. Each system is compared with default evidence rendering under the same QA configuration.
blocks.zh: 我们在SimleMem、LightMem、A-Mem、Zep和Mem0上应用同样的RQS模块,同时保留每个系统的内存构造和检索。 一份固定的适配器地图检索了内存单位以备注,在可用日期之前将其分组,并去除每组内的确切重复. 具体方法的字段与这种共同表述方式正常化;没有时间元数据的单位被放在未注明日期的会话中。 每个系统都与默认证据在相同的QA配置下进行比较.

blocks.en: Removing RQS reduces overall accuracy by 6.25% on LongMemEval and 4.44% on LoCoMo, with the largest declines on temporal questions, as shown in Tables 8 and 9 . Transplantation improves all five memory systems by 2.75–9.25% on LongMemEval, as shown in Figure 3 . Table 10 provides the question-type breakdown. Gains vary across categories; on LoCoMo, removing RQS improves single-hop accuracy despite reducing overall performance.
